name: Container Corporation
title: Transcript of post results conference call held on 03.11.2026

read.thesis: CONCOR H1 FY27 handling up 4.48% with domestic only 4.22%, far below the 15% domestic FY27 guide, and management declined to reaffirm guidance until December; JNPT rail coefficient 12.88% is not comparable.

capex.quote: our MOU target is INR800 crores, but internal target is INR945 crores and in the first half, as I told you, we have done INR418 crores

triggers.label: Dadri/TKD tariffs cut 10-20%
triggers.quote: So 10% to 20% price reductions we have effected.

triggers.label: Guidance not reaffirmed; review in December
triggers.quote: So we'll review our guidance in the month of December. Right now, we are just keeping quiet as far as guidance is concerned

triggers.label: H1 handling up 4.48%; domestic 4.22%
triggers.quote: Throughput in the H1 in the EXIM segment has increased by 4.57% and domestic segment, 4.22%, total 4.48%.

triggers.label: Domestic EBIT margin near 2%, competition
triggers.quote: So there is a strong competition. We are not the lone participant in the market.
